verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken layout. The spec grid is broken up and scattered: 40 h and BT 5.4 sit on top of the teal circle and get in the way of the tagline, while 10 min, 250 g, -38 dB and 6 mics float in random places. The tagline is jammed against the logo and the headline. The legal line is set as large as body copy, and the circle no longer holds the headphones. They differ only in the logo: A's is a bit larger and easier to read, while B's is tiny and close to illegible.
